subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should OpenRouter music generation honor the existing explicit `models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork` option instead of always forcing public-network-only requests?
rationale: The implementation is consistent with the shared provider HTTP contract and an existing Google media precedent, but it intentionally changes a network security boundary and repository policy reserves that acceptance for the owning maintainer.

options.title: Honor the shared policy
options.body: Accept the existing explicit headers, proxy, TLS, and private-network request policy for OpenRouter music, then refresh the branch and required checks.

options.title: Keep music public-only
options.body: Preserve the hard-coded private-network denial and narrow forwarding to request settings that cannot permit private destinations.

recommendation.title: Honor the shared policy
recommendation.body: Accept the existing explicit headers, proxy, TLS, and private-network request policy for OpenRouter music, then refresh the branch and required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged OpenRouter provider-policy work makes this the best available owner for the capability-level decision.
